sources.author: Blender Studio and community contributors
sources.changes: Retained body and two eye objects with modifiers removed. Coat and trouser regions are selected from body topology, cut, inflated, weighted and remapped into a forward seated adult riding pose. The source body head and eye geometry are not exported; the full-face mask, head cowl and felt hat are original generated geometry.

generated.originalWork: Character design, full-face silver masks, felt hat, head cowl, targeted garment fold sculptures, rolled linings/cuffs/hems, gloves, boots, cloth panels, broom, crown, props, weights, rigs, shoulder motion and looping actions.
generated.materials: Original procedural 256px weave albedo encodes the linear source palette into sRGB pixel values. The 512px tangent-space textile normal/roughness images stay Non-Color. Authored PBR material values and cloth sheen are retained. Current GLBs do not load the archived Cortu hair images or external cloth/leather texture packs.
generated.gltfSheenMapping: The builder normalizes KHR_materials_sheen.sheenColorFactor to source Principled Sheen Tint multiplied by Sheen Weight, correcting Blender 5.1's omitted weight. Editable source rigs retain their authored shader values. This normalization preserves all non-sheen material fields and all binary mesh, skin, image and animation chunks.
